newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATI first half container volume up 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: ATI first half container volume up 39 pct.

text.p: Asian Terminal Inc (ATI) said on Monday container throughput rose 39 percent in the first six months to December 1996.
ATI's fiscal year ends in June.

The Manila south harbour operator said in a statement it processed 261,569.5 twenty foot equivalent units (TEUs) in the six month period, up from 188,375.25 TEUs in the same period in the previous year.
The company has projected a 25 to 30 percent increase in its container volume for the current fiscal year. ATI services 36 percent of the international container market.
The company said it is currently expanding its quayline for container vessels to 1,356 metres from the present 1,100 metres.
It is also ordering new ship-to-shore cranes and refurbishing the old ones to increase efficiency.
